  Foundations of EV and Hybrid Vehicles [ELE-3127]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           How does the government policy and regulation impact the growth of the electric  
  vehicle industry?  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      How does the energy density of an EV battery affect its range and performance?              (2)  
  C)      How do you calculate the range of an electric vehicle based on battery capacity, energy  
  consumption, and driving conditions?                                                        (4)  
  
  2)           Given the following data for a lithium iron phosphate (LFP) prismatic cell battery pack:  
  Nominal voltage of each LFP cell: 3.2 V  
  Capacity of each LFP cell: 200 Ah  
  A)      Battery pack voltage: 800 V  
  Average energy consumption: 1000 Wh/km                                                   (4)  
  Desired range: 250 km  
  Calculate (a) Number of cell in series, (b) Cell Energy, (c) Battery pack energy (d)  
  Battery pack capacity (e) Number of cells in parallel  
  
  B)      A 36 kWh battery pack can be fast charged from 0% to 80% SOC in 30 min. Determine  
  the approximate charge current and power in order to achieve this charge time.    (4)  
  
  C)      A Li-ion cell is rated at 3.2 V, 3.2 Ah at 0.2C and has an internal resistance of 40 mΩ.  
  Determine (a) The cell Wh, (b) Ah, and (c) efficiency for the 8C rate.                      (4)  
  
  3)           Describe the function of the Battery Management System (BMS) in monitoring the  
  health and performance of the battery pack.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      What safety precautions should be followed when handling high-voltage systems in  
  electric vehicles??                                                                         (3)  
  
  C)      What are the main differences between Level 1, Level 2, and DC fast charging in terms  
  of charging speed, voltage, and power supply?                                               (4)  
  
  4)           What are the parameters that should be considered to calculate the efficiency of the        (4)  
  powertrain in an electric vehicle in working condition?
